card.name: Risk statements in warning text
card.fires_on: Single words in boxed-warning style sentences about risk, such as "suicidal" after "one case of", "may" after "Tissue loading" or "This risk", and sentence-opening "The" or "We".

modes.label: Risk wording
modes.description: "suicidal" or "may" inside a sentence stating a risk or a possible effect.
modes.example: representing an increase of approximately one case of<< suicidal>> thinking or behavior for every 53

modes.label: Sentence-opening word
modes.description: "The" or "We" starting a sentence right after a full stop in trial or website text.
modes.example: in over 4400 patients.<< The>> pooled analyses of placebo-controlled trials in adults

card.writes: Promotes words meaning prevent or absolutely and suppresses words meaning short-term or containing, so no clear overall effect on the output.
card.plain: It lights up on small words inside warning sentences about risks, like "may" or "suicidal".
